groups.label: Admission, static preparation and raw lowering
Initial optimizer plus first independent verifier
Observer permission, discovery and selected final admission

intervals.label: observer composition and selected final admission
render/output and teardown until milestone exit

nestedConditionalFinalVerifier.scope: One actual conditional final-verifier entry to writer; includes return/continuation overhead. Nested in observer-composition interval, do not add.

diagnosticComparison.note: One observation each. Different diagnostic runtime/sampler images, same compiler program object/input/output. Not an overhead-neutral clean timing or a statistical estimate.

parserAttribution.reason: The active dispatch is f_find; caller overwritten. Current CFI coverage is libc only. Phase membership does not identify individual f_find call sites.

limits: Stage clocks include continuations/reference management between exact entries; no causal speedup bound follows.
Only first entry to render drain is a boundary; subsequent drain calls are counted and intentionally permitted.
One sample at each end of an interval is excluded because clock/ordinal observations are not atomic with signal delivery.
Short or quality-failed stage histograms remain descriptive, not quantitative CPU estimates. No independent samples or confidence interval assumed.
After first render drain, render/output/final cleanup remain a combined tail, not exclusive render cost.
Diagnostic timing includes profiler overhead and must not replace the clean baseline.
